description: Landscape III — Colore: Raw umber texture Collezione: Polpo Codice: 7075 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Landscape Altezza: 58.26 cm Toni: Brown Born in Venice. Hand-crafted by our 35 artisans. Using the original machines still in operation at our Venice factory, we have developed new techniques that extend the processes established by Mariano Fortuny over a century ago to create a collection of fabric landscapes that recall the natural world. The textiles of LANDSCAPE III echo the reflections and refraction of light through the waters of Venice’s canals and lagoon. Landscape III interprets water as abstraction. Shifting bands of light and color dissolve structure, creating a fabric that feels fluid, reflective, and continuously in motion. Part of the POLPO Collection .
